suspicions.smell: Per-agent call count in t_codegen_per_agent_calls uses a raw pointer as a key without checking if the agent context remains valid or if the map is thread-safe across async interpreter boundaries.
Updating per-agent call counts using a raw pointer as a key; if the agent context is destroyed and a new one is allocated at the same address, the counter will be incorrectly reused.

Manual comment stripping for TypeScript wrapping is fragile and can be bypassed by complex string/comment nesting, potentially leading to incorrect code injection.
